notes.random: It is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. This strategy was picked from the pc_es_v2_15m finalists using their 2023–2024 results (Sharpe, beats-luck, a one-setting-at-a-time neighbor check on 2023–2024) as well as 2018–2022, so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice. The untouched test is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: First convexity look at the ES holdout. No price-path convexity strategy had been scored on 2025 onward before (apart from the final-test of this same frozen pick), and only this one, frozen beforehand, was run, so there's no selection among holdout results. Other strategy families were scored on ES 2025+ earlier (see the data-access ledgers).

legs.settings_text: 15m bars, paper convexity over N = 15 bars, z-score over 150 bars, enter at |z| 0.5, only with the net move (early), net move at least 3 ATR, long only, hold N bars, 2.5-ATR stop, EMA(50) trend filter, flat at the close
